subject.title: feat(macos): hardware H.264 video pipeline for Share This Mac

question: Should this PR require live two-Mac Share This Mac proof before merge, or is the reported build/test evidence enough to accept the new default H.264 path?
rationale: The diff changes the default streaming path for existing native Mac viewer sessions, and the PR body explicitly says live hardware validation is still pending.

options.title: Require live Mac proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live host/viewer evidence before merge and re-review once it is posted.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: A maintainer may override the proof gate and accept the upgrade risk from build and loopback-test claims alone.

options.title: Narrow before proof
options.body: Keep H.264 available only behind an opt-in or non-default path until live validation is available.

recommendation.title: Require live Mac proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live host/viewer evidence before merge and re-review once it is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest history owner for the macOS Share This Mac and RoyalVNCKit paths touched here.
